messages.subject: Nimble Simulation Problem with dcat
parts:
Hi All,

I am facing a problem while doing a simulation of the basic Cormack Jolly Seber model using Nimble. For simulation whenever I am using dcat, I am always getting warnings for Dynamic Index Out of bounds. I attached the R-code for this here. It will be great if any of you provide me with some guidance on how can I resolve this problem. Is it possible doing the simulation like this?

library(nimble)
# Define the model code
code_sim <- nimbleCode({
  # Priors
  phi ~ dunif(0, 1)   # Survival Probability
  p ~ dunif(0, 1)     # Capture Probability
 
  # Observation process probabilities
  po[1, 1] <- 1 - p
  po[1, 2] <- p
  po[2, 1] <- 1
  po[2, 2] <- 0
 
  # Latent state process probabilities
  px[1, 1] <- phi
  px[1, 2] <- 1 - phi
  px[2, 1] <- 0
  px[2, 2] <- 1
 
  # Simulating data
  for (i in 1:N) {
    # Initial state
    alive[i, 1] ~ dcat(px[1, 1:2])
   
    for (j in 2:nyears) {
      # State transition
      alive[i, j] ~ dcat(px[alive[i, j - 1], 1:2])
     
      # Observation process
      mydata[i, j] ~ dcat(po[alive[i, j], 1:2])
    }
  }
})

N <- 5      # Number of individuals
nyears <-  3  # Number of sampling years
num_datasets <- 2  # Number of datasets to simulate

# Create a list to store simulated datasets
simulated_datasets <- list()

# Simulate datasets
for (s in 1:num_datasets) {
  sim_model <- nimbleModel(code_sim, constants = list(N = N, nyears = nyears))
 
  # Set initial parameter values
  sim_model$phi <- runif(1, 0.4, 0.6)
  sim_model$p <- runif(1, 0.3, 0.5)
 
  # Initialize the initial state for each individual
  initial_states <- sample(1:2, N, replace = TRUE)
  sim_model$z <- initial_states
 
  # Get nodes for simulation
  sim_nodes <- sim_model$getDependencies(c("alive", "mydata"), self = FALSE)
 
  # Simulate the data
  sim_model$simulate(sim_nodes)
 
  # Store the simulated data in the list
  simulated_datasets[[s]] <- list(alive = sim_model$alive, mydata = sim_model$mydata)
}
